title: API N+1 query storm
alert: The shop frontend loads, but product pages take 3-5 seconds to render since this morning.

truth.root_cause: api 2.3.2 introduced an N+1 query pattern in the product listing: it fetches products with one query, then issues a separate query for each product's category and stock, overwhelming the database with thousands of tiny queries per page load.
truth.fix: Roll back api to 2.3.1, then verify product pages load in under 100 ms again. Long term: fix the query to use a single JOIN or batch load.
